$comment: Pins the SDK band: .NET 11 since 0.1.0-beta.37 (owner decision D94, 2026-11-11). Without this, dotnet picks the newest installed SDK — on a machine with a .NET 12 preview present that silently changes analyzer behaviour under TreatWarningsAsErrors and makes local and CI disagree for reasons invisible in a diff. The alpha branch carries this same file while its line rests. See docs/12_BUILD.md.
